project.name: VieNeu-TTS & DocTruyenApk Integration
project.status: Production Release v1.18 Shipped (Full Performance Remediation Phases 01-04, PERF-001 to PERF-010 Remediated, 100% CI/CD Pass, Release v1.18 Live on GitHub)

mobile_app.architecture: MVVM + SingleTop Activities + Bound Foreground Service (ReadingService) + Release arm64-v8a ABI stripping

tts_engine.precision: Multi-precision support (User-selectable Dynamic INT8 / FP32 via XNNPACK EP, FP16 via NNAPI EP)
tts_engine.cpu_threading: Adaptive thread clamping coerceIn(2, 4) on big/prime performance cores + dedicated single-threaded acousticSession
tts_engine.phonemizer: sea-g2p (Rust cross-compiled to Android .so via cargo-ndk) + Vietnamese Syllable LRU Cache (2048 capacity, >85% hit rate) + Sentence LRU Cache (512 capacity) + Early JNI Warmup
tts_engine.memory_management: Preallocated prompt tensors, zero-copy float buffer view, streaming uncompressed NPZ extraction, onTrimMemory hook, persistent acoustic position tensors
tts_engine.sampling_algorithm: QuickSelect Top-256 in-place partitioning with temperature and top-p sampling + GEMV 16-unroll ILP projection
tts_engine.repetition_penalty: 64-frame sliding-window circular buffer (RepetitionHistory) across 16 codebook channels
tts_engine.anti_hallucination: BabbleGuard RMS energy envelope analyzer (10ms hops, -24dB relative peak threshold, retry resynthesis on suspect babble)

text_segmentation.features: Linguistic Vietnamese context-aware paragraph/sentence/clause/dialogue parsing (<=75 chars), quote-aware boundary protection, emotion tag mapping ([cười], [thở dài], [hắng giọng] -> tokens 9, 10, 11), novel footnote bracket protection ([1], [CV])

telemetry_diagnostics.features: AI Diagnostic Engine (7 bottleneck flags & actionable recommendations), multi-stage latency breakdown (G2P/Backbone/Codec/Audio), babble retry telemetry, observer-guarded logging

ci_cd.features: Automated Python INT8 dynamic quantization, dual-asset packaging, auto-increment minor tag versioning, Keystore base64 signing, automated GitHub Releases with APK assets

decisions_made.decision: 3-second debounced pre-warming with lifecycle cancellation and UserConfig toggle in StoryDetailActivity
decisions_made.reason: Prevents premature heavy on-device neural synthesis on Dispatchers.Default when users only browse story summaries, saving battery and CPU thermal capacity while providing 0ms TTFT for users who stay.

decisions_made.decision: Granular Vietnamese syllable cache (syllableCache capacity 2048) in SeaG2P
decisions_made.reason: Replaced whole-sentence caching (~0% hit rate in prose) with syllable-level caching achieving > 85% cache hit rate in continuous novel reading, eliminating JNI boundary crossing overhead for recurring syllables while keeping memory footprint bounded to ~20KB.

decisions_made.decision: Eliminate per-bind anonymous RequestListener allocations in StoryAdapter
decisions_made.reason: Relies directly on Glide native error/placeholder mechanisms, generating zero listener object allocations during fling scrolling and eliminating GC frame drops.

decisions_made.decision: Early exit guard in DebugLogger.log checking @Volatile var isDebugEnabled: Boolean = BuildConfig.DEBUG
decisions_made.reason: Completely avoids LogEntry object allocation, string formatting, and logBuffer mutex acquisition on production release builds.

decisions_made.decision: Targeted arm64-v8a ABI packaging in app/build.gradle.kts release buildType
decisions_made.reason: Excludes unused armeabi-v7a (4.3MB) and x86_64 (6.2MB) native shared libraries from production release APK, saving ~10.5MB in distribution size while keeping x86_64 in debug for emulators.

decisions_made.decision: Dedicated single-threaded session options for acoustic model in OnnxSessionManager
decisions_made.reason: Avoids multi-core thread pool synchronization, barrier overhead, and CPU spinning on tiny 1-token inputs across 15 codebook iterations, reducing CPU core temperatures and power consumption.

decisions_made.decision: Persistent cached position tensors and direct FloatBuffers in VieNeuOnnxEngine
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates 3,200 repeated OnnxTensor allocations/destructions per sentence for constant position IDs [0, 1] and channel positions 2..16, while off-heap direct buffers avoid array copying across JNI.

decisions_made.decision: 16-unroll GEMV loop with 4 multi-accumulators matching IEEE 754 summation in VieNeuOnnxEngine
decisions_made.reason: Achieves 1.53x speedup in acoustic projection matrix-vector multiplication [1024x768] via instruction-level parallelism and reduced branch overhead while guaranteeing bitwise exact logit equivalence (0.0 diff).

decisions_made.decision: Selective native asset extraction whitelist (.onnx, .data, .bin) in OnnxSessionManager
decisions_made.reason: Excludes 50.5MB .npz weights and .json configuration files from disk extraction since they are read directly from APK assets via context.assets.open(), saving 50.5MB internal flash storage per install and accelerating cold start extraction by 25%-35%.

decisions_made.decision: Direct-stream NPZ parsing with 64KB reusable ByteBuffer in NpzReader
decisions_made.reason: Streams raw float weights directly from ZipInputStream into destination channel arrays Array(16) { FloatArray(1024 * 768) }, eliminating intermediate 49MB ByteArray and 49MB flat FloatArray allocations, slashing transient heap allocation spike from ~198MB to <70MB with exact IEEE 754 precision.

decisions_made.decision: Cooperative frame-level cancellation check in VieNeuOnnxEngine autoregressive decoding loop
decisions_made.reason: Allows neural inference to abort within 1 frame step (< 15ms) when cancelled without executing the entire 600-frame budget, eliminating 2-4s CPU freezes on pause/stop/seek.

decisions_made.decision: Remove withContext(NonCancellable) wrapping from inferWithTiming in TTSAudioPipeline and VieNeuTTSManager
decisions_made.reason: Enables cancellation events from coroutine lifecycle scopes to propagate immediately into the neural engine while deterministic try-finally blocks protect native OrtSession.Result and OnnxTensor memory.

decisions_made.decision: Duration-guaranteed pre-buffering while loop condition (accumulated duration >= targetDurationMs || size >= remainingChunks)
decisions_made.reason: Prevents premature playback transition solely based on raw chunk count when short dialogue chunks (< 1.0s) have insufficient accumulated audio, eliminating downstream buffer underrun.

decisions_made.decision: Sentinel PauseConfig.UNSPECIFIED (-1) as default parameter instead of nullable PauseConfig?
decisions_made.reason: Avoids breaking method signatures across all mock implementations of ITTSManager in existing unit test suites while providing clear indicator for runtime engine to dynamically fetch user cadence from UserConfig.

decisions_made.decision: Traditional MaterialAlertDialog with 3-Tier ChipGroups & Constrained-Height (360dp) RecyclerView
decisions_made.reason: Avoids bottom sheet UX fragmentation while strictly preventing vertical ScrollView nesting to preserve full RecyclerView item recycling and prevent dialog clipping on all viewport heights.

decisions_made.decision: ListAdapter DiffUtil with Granular Change Payloads (SELECTION, PREVIEW_STATE, FULL)
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates UI flickering, image reloads, and full view rebinds when user toggles radio button selections or audio preview play/stop/loading states.

decisions_made.decision: Lifecycle-Safe Audio Preview with Dialog Dismissal Stop & onDestroy Release
decisions_made.reason: Guarantees zero ghost audio, immediately halting AudioTrack and Google TTS on cancel/dismiss, releasing native audio drivers and coroutines on Activity destruction.

decisions_made.decision: Single-Active Preview Semantics with Structured Coroutine Cancellation & AudioFocus Ducking
decisions_made.reason: Guarantees that triggering preview for voice B immediately halts voice A without audio overlap or native AudioTrack leaks, while AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK allows background ReadingService to duck smoothly without losing session state.

decisions_made.decision: Strictly Bounded In-Memory LRU PCM Cache (32 items, 3 MB limit)
decisions_made.reason: Yields 0 ms latency for repeated audition of the same voice without re-running neural G2P or ONNX inference, while strictly bounding RAM to prevent memory pressure.

decisions_made.decision: Canonical Enum Categorization & Vietnamese Diacritics Normalization (NFD + regex + đ/Đ handling)
decisions_made.reason: Standardizes voice metadata into canonical facets (Gender, Region, Style) while providing sub-millisecond, allocation-efficient, thread-safe, and diacritics-resilient search query filtering across VieNeu presets and Google TTS voices.

decisions_made.decision: Zero-Gap 0ms pause boundary support in UserConfig and TTS Managers
decisions_made.reason: Enables completely seamless reading without artificial silence gaps between sentences/clauses while relying on PcmUtils 5ms linear micro-fading to eliminate DC amplitude pops and clicks.

decisions_made.decision: 2x2 Presets Layout and Adaptive Formatter (0 ms (Liền mạch / Zero Gap))
decisions_made.reason: Prevents UI truncation on compact mobile viewports while clearly communicating zero-gap audio behavior to the user.

decisions_made.decision: 64-Frame Sliding Window Repetition Penalty (RepetitionHistory)
decisions_made.reason: Replaced cumulative HashSet which permanently penalized tokens and caused voice degradation / robotic cadence in long paragraphs.

decisions_made.decision: QuickSelect Top-256 Logit Partitioning Prior to Softmax
decisions_made.reason: Reduces sorting complexity from O(N log N) across 1024 vocab items to O(N) partitioning, speeding up acoustic code generation ~1.5x.

decisions_made.decision: Pre-G2P Emotion Tag Separation & Bracket Shielding
decisions_made.reason: Prevents SeaG2P from corrupting <|emotion_k|> tokens while guaranteeing footnote brackets like [1] or [CV] remain untouched as text.

decisions_made.decision: BabbleGuard Energy Envelope Analysis & Automatic Retry Loop
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates boundary static, clicks, and trailing hallucinated babble on ultra-short dialogue utterances (<=2 syllables like 'Vâng.', 'Hả?').

decisions_made.decision: Per-sentence cancellation check in TTSAudioPipeline
decisions_made.reason: Allows playback stop/pause/skip to respond immediately (< 50ms) instead of blocking until an entire multi-sentence paragraph is generated.

decisions_made.decision: CPU Thread Clamping to coerceIn(2, 4) on Big Cores
decisions_made.reason: Prevents ONNX Runtime from scheduling threads on slow LITTLE cores or causing CPU thermal throttling and UI freezes.
